Name: (AT) Beatles Albums as Furniture
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
[font=Tahoma]Have you ever felt like your pixelated farming game was lacking in 60s boy band content? Now you'll never have to feel that way again with the [b][u]Beatles Furniture[/u][/b] content pack!

[size=4]Content[/size]
This mod adds pixel art of various Beatles-related album covers into the game through Alternative Textures, replacing the [b]Sun #44[/b] painting. This pixel art was all made by my own hand!

The [b]1.1[/b] version currently includes all thirteen albums released by the Beatles, as well as most albums made by John Lennon as a solo artist. Future updates will expand to include the other band members' solo albums.

[size=4]Installation and Removal
[/size]1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] if you haven't already, this mod won't work without it!
2. Download this mod.
3. Unzip and put the file where you put the rest of your Stardew Valley mods in your Mods folder.
4. Launch game! To use the albums, you must purchase a paint bucket from Robin's shop and use it on a painting.
(5. If you have decided that it is The End (pardon the pun) for this mod, all you've gotta do is delete the file from the Mods folder! Easy as that.)

[size=4]Credits
[/size]The Stardew Discord server for giving me lots of encouragement and support as I worked on the pixel art and made this mod!

Atlasphere for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14644]West Elm Furniture[/url] mod and Nano for the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16029]Retro Style Furniture[/url] mod, which are featured in the example image; everything besides the album art themselves are from those two mods.

Check out my [url=https://ko-fi.com/vinilla]ko-fi[/url] or [url=https://vinilla.carrd.co/]carrd[/url] if you enjoyed my mod! Thanks for checking it out~[/font]
